lead: Britney Spears is a widely followed American singer, born on 2 December 1981 in McComb.

She is associated with work such as...Baby One More Time, Oops!... I Did It Again and Toxic and has been recognised with Amadeus Austrian Music Awards and American Music Award for Favorite Pop/Rock Song.

sections.heading: Britney Spears — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Britney Spears was born on 2 December 1981 in McComb, and holds American nationality. She was given the name Britney Jean Spears at birth and is publicly known as Britney Spears.
Public records name her father, James Parnell Spears and her mother, Lynne Spears. She is a sibling of Jamie Lynn Spears and Bryan Spears.
She received her education at Parklane Academy, University of Nebraska High School and Professional Performing Arts School.
She is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Britney Spears — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists singer, songwriter, dancer, actor, composer and pop musician as her occupations.
Among the credits most often linked to Britney are...Baby One More Time, Oops!... I Did It Again and Toxic.
She performs on voice and piano.
